body:
Adds owner-approved direct patient family links with five relationship labels, explicit inverse direction, one active pair and manual patient selection. Both endpoints require existing patient policies. Merges suppress original links without transferring them; unmerge restores eligible original links. Consultation shows only authorized direct relatives waiting today and a patient link, never their clinical conditions or billing/contact data.

Includes the approved two-table migration, canonical sorted locking, actor-bound version/idempotency commands, append-only evidence, UI and meaningful feature/contention tests. No shared-phone suggestions, transitive groups, guardian authority, new grant or existing assertion change. Emergency Contact and Consultation restyle #1136 remain separately scoped.

The static recovery refreshes main e5e72f69b normally and fixes only braces/formatting in the new frontend test. Ten ESLint errors were reproduced locally. Independent review confirms all six cases, fixtures and assertions are preserved; domain/controller/migration parity is exact.

Fresh local validation passes: backend 14 tests/62 assertions, actual contention 5 tests/32 assertions, feature frontend 6/6, full frontend 2,209/2,209 with no skips, repository lint/format, frontend types/build, Pint and PHPStan. Earlier backend CI shards 1–3 passed; updated-head remote CI remains required. Prior synthetic UI review is carried evidence, not a new browser run for this test-only formatting correction.

Draft PR. No production migration, merge or new business scope is requested.
